description: 法兰联轴器半体（法兰盘+轴孔+键槽+螺栓孔）
description_en: A flange coupling half with bore, keyway and bolt holes
code:
import cadquery as cq
import math

# === 参数 ===
flange_d = 120     # 法兰外径 (mm)
flange_t = 18      # 法兰厚度 (mm)
hub_d = 60         # 轮毂外径 (mm)
hub_len = 50       # 轮毂长度 (mm)
bore_d = 30        # 轴孔直径 (mm)
keyway_w = 10      # 键槽宽度 (mm)
keyway_depth = 5   # 键槽深度 (mm)
bolt_d = 12        # 螺栓孔直径 (mm)
bolt_pcd = 90      # 螺栓孔分布圆直径 (mm)
bolt_count = 6     # 螺栓孔数量
recess_d = 20      # 定心凸缘直径差
recess_h = 3       # 定心凸缘高度 (mm)

# === 轮毂 ===
result = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .circle(hub_d / 2)
    .extrude(hub_len)
)

# === 法兰盘 ===
flange = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .workplane(offset=hub_len)
    .circle(flange_d / 2)
    .extrude(flange_t)
)
result = result.union(flange)

# === 定心凸缘 ===
recess = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .workplane(offset=hub_len + flange_t)
    .circle(hub_d / 2 + recess_d / 2)
    .extrude(recess_h)
)
result = result.union(recess)

# === 轴孔 (贯通) ===
result = result.faces(">Z").workplane().hole(bore_d)

# === 键槽 ===
total_len = hub_len + flange_t + recess_h
keyway = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .center(bore_d / 2, 0)
    .rect(keyway_depth * 2, keyway_w)
    .extrude(total_len)
)
result = result.cut(keyway)

# === 螺栓孔 ===
result = (
    result
    .faces(">Z").workplane(offset=-recess_h)
    .polarArray(bolt_pcd / 2, 0, 360, bolt_count)
    .hole(bolt_d)
)

# === 倒角 ===
result = result.faces("<Z").chamfer(1.5)

show_object(result)
